name: Da Nang
provinceNote: Da Nang city now includes the former Quang Nam province, so Hoi An and My Son sit inside it.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Stay in Da Nang when you want the airport, a long beach, and a city that still feels like a city. Stay in Hoi An when the night in the old town is the point. The two are under an hour apart, so sleep in one and ride to the other.
timeNeeded: 1–2 days, plus nights if you prefer a beach hotel to Hoi An
fee: No single city ticket. The beach is free.
getThere: Da Nang International Airport (DAD) is a short ride from the river. Hoi An is about 30 minutes on from the Marble Mountains.
seoTitle: Da Nang travel guide — beach, airport, and the ride to Hoi An
seoDescription: Sleep in Da Nang for the beach and a 10–15 minute airport ride, or in Hoi An for the old town. January to July is the drier window on the coast.
intro: Give the first morning to the Cham Museum, on the Han River, before the sand. A general ticket is 60,000 VND and an hour is enough. The stone comes from My Son and the other Cham sites. The galleries are not the ruins. The door time is published as both 07:00 and 07:30, and both say it closes at 17:00, so confirm that morning.

Son Tra is the view that is not a theme park. The Quan The Am at Linh Ung is 67 meters and faces the sea, and the peninsula ride is half a day. No entry fee is published. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes from the center, on the road you will already take toward Hoi An. Climb Thuy Son. That hill is 40,000 VND. Am Phu cave is a second ticket.

Dragon Bridge is the evening picture from the river path. The fire-and-water show is at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, not on an ordinary weeknight. Hai Van, north toward Hue, is a clear-weather detour by car or with a licensed rider. The train to Hue is about three hours if you would rather not drive the pass.
gettingAround: The airport is about 10–15 minutes from the center by car. Grab is the easy way across town. The beach and the river are far enough that you will not walk from dinner to your hotel, so pick a base and stay with it. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, and Hoi An is about 30 minutes further by the coastal road. North–south trains stop at Ga Da Nang.

stayAreas.name: My Khe beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the sea is why you picked the city. The streets just inland from My Khe and My An are where the restaurants and beach bars sit. The museum and Hoi An are a ride.

stayAreas.name: Han River
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if you want the museum, Dragon Bridge, and dinner on foot. The beach becomes a ride, which is a fair trade if you like a city morning.

eat: Start with mi Quang at lunch and bun cha ca in the morning. Seafood is the My Khe dinner. The food guide names the shops, the river breakfast, and where to go after dark.
interestsBody: My Khe is the swim, in the drier months, and the bars sit on the streets just inland. This guide does not name one.
The Cham Museum is the cultural hour, on the river, before you commit the day to the beach. It is not a stand-in for My Son.
Dragon Bridge is the evening walk. For lanterns and cao lau, ride to Hoi An.

interestCards.title: Beach
interestCards.summary: Swim at My Khe in the drier months.

interestCards.title: Beach bars
interestCards.summary: Umbrellas, palms, and the streets just inland. No single bar is the recommendation.

interestCards.title: Cham Museum
interestCards.summary: Cham sculpture on the Han River.

interestCards.title: Golden Bridge
interestCards.summary: A full day in the hills, for the bridge in the stone hands.

interestCards.title: Da Nang Food Guide
interestCards.summary: Mi Quang at lunch, bun cha ca in the morning, seafood on My Khe.

season.label: Drier beach months
season.note: The city’s English page calls January to July dry and August to December wet, with the heaviest rain in October and November. The Vietnamese page calls January to September dry and puts floods in September to November. Treat September as unsettled, and check the Hoi An road and Hai Van on the morning you go.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Da Nang or Hoi An?
faqs.a: Sleep in Hoi An if the old town at night is the reason you came. Sleep in Da Nang if you want a beach morning and a shorter airport ride. See the other city as a ride, not as a second hotel move in the same day.

faqs.q: When does Dragon Bridge breathe fire?
faqs.a: At 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and on major holidays. It is not a weeknight show. During the fireworks festival the night can move, so check that week.
